run_libsize_check: run libsize.py to display the file size of a .so library and save it
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare a .so file size against a previously saved baseline
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py to create a new baseline size file for a .so library
run_libsize_change: run libsize.py to report the byte and percentage change of a .so file size
run_libsize_update: run libsize.py to overwrite a saved size file with the current .so file size
